additional_info.subject: ID0367353-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117103] Mainfan_GQ1 CRM:00315001559
additional_info.body:
Hello Emre-abi﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R7 313065117103
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
ehWTcL
Problem Description
: Mainfan error
Troubleshooting
:
Usually this error appears when there is no power reaching the fan.
Please check if from L3 which comes from FC20 we are getting the 230V
Then check the XD7.1B which is the connector above the SECCs. Check if we receive the 230V in the input and output of the connector.
If not then please remove  the connector and reinsert.
Check for possible loose wirings.
Please schedule a meeting with me for proper remote support.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0367353
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: ID0367353-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117103] Mainfan_GQ1 CRM:00315001559
additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan and Emre,
After today's assistance from Furkan, we were able to remove the error of the Fan by checking the XD7.1B for 230V input and removing and reinserting this same connector.
As Furkan mentioned, let's keep this ticket open since he is near this site tomorrow.  If anything happens by tomorrow we can continue investigating.
From the SCB logs we were able to see that the Fan is spinning during a charging session:
So from my side, everything looks good for the moment.
We will discuss again tomorrow the next steps.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
